title: Holding Tight to the Lord
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Good Hezekiah was the king,
He loved the Lord so true,
He put the idols all away
And taught the people too.

[Chorus]
When troubles come, I know the way,
I look to God each day,
I hold Him tight, He holds me too,
And close to me He'll stay.

[Verse 2]
He held on tight to God alone,
He chose Him first of all,
When troubles came, he knew to turn
And on the Lord to call.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, my little one,
And trust Him through the night,
Heavenly Father's here with you,
He holds you close and tight.

[Chorus]
mood: Steady music. A firm, even walking pulse sits under the voice, like a king who knows exactly where he is going and never wavers, matching Hezekiah's sure hold on the Lord. Each verse keeps that same sure footing while the chorus opens a little warmer and wider. By the last verse the steps grow slower and softer, the pulse sinks low, and the song settles into a quiet, held stillness.
